cases.title: Initiate drag event and capture product title and price
cases.description: Verify that dragging a product item (li element with draggable='true' and data-testid='product-item-1') initiates a drag event and captures the product's title (from data-testid='product-title-1') and price (from data-testid='product-price-1') for transfer.

cases.title: Drag and drop product items to update cart display
cases.description: Verify that dragging and dropping a product item into the designated drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area') updates the cart display such that the product title appears in .box2, the unit price in .box3, and the quantity in .box1, supporting both different and repeated products.

cases.title: Calculate and Display Total Price in Cart
cases.description: Verify that the system calculates the total price by summing the prices of all products in the cart, formats the total to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol (e.g., '$80.00'), and displays the result in the <div id="allMoney"> element.

opinions.feedback: The test cases adequately cover the provided requirements without any blockers, speculative tests, or missing distinct operations.
All test cases correctly map to the requirements and are valid, non-redundant, and verifiable.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-1 describes multiple distinct behaviors including initiating a drag event, capturing the product title, and capturing the product price for transfer from 'li' elements with 'draggable' set to 'true'. Normal test scenario is warranted for successful drag initiation and data transfer. Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-3 describes multiple distinct behaviors including dragging and dropping product items into the designated drop area, updating the cart display (.box1 for quantity, .box2 for title, .box3 for unit price), and supporting both different and repeated products. Normal test scenarios are warranted for adding single, different, and repeated products. Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-5 describes multiple distinct behaviors including summing product prices, formatting the total to two decimal places with the currency symbol, and displaying the result in the <div id="allMoney"> element. A Normal test scenario is warranted for total price calculation and display.
